readings: Treat an order as large when `order.amount >= 2802`. Join each large order to its account and the account’s district, excluding orders without a matching account or district. For each (`order.account_id`, `district.A3`) group, calculate the average order amount. Calculate the simple average of those group averages. Return the 10 groups with the largest positive difference between their group average and that overall average, showing account id, region, group average, and difference, sorted by difference descending, without rounding.

Treat an order as large when `order.amount > 2802`. Join each large order to its account and the account’s district, excluding orders without a matching account or district. For each (`order.account_id`, `district.A3`) group, calculate the average order amount. Calculate the simple average of those group averages. Return the 10 groups with the largest positive difference between their group average and that overall average, showing account id, region, group average, and difference, sorted by difference descending, without rounding.
queries:
WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS group_average
    FROM "order" AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount >= 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_average) AS average_of_groups
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
    g.account_id,
    g.region,
    g.group_average,
    g.group_average - v.average_of_groups AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS v
WHERE g.group_average > v.average_of_groups
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT o.account_id,
           d.A3 AS region,
           AVG(o.amount) AS group_average
    FROM "order" AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount > 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_average) AS average_of_group_averages
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.account_id,
       g.region,
       g.group_average,
       g.group_average - oa.average_of_group_averages AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE g.group_average > oa.average_of_group_averages
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
